title: CBIC Extends TV Set Compliance Timeline for IS 18112:2022 to January 26, 2027
content:
# CBIC Extends TV Set Compliance Timeline for IS 18112:2022 to January 26, 2027

Ek important update hai! Government ne television sets ke liye IS 18112:2022 compliance timeline extend karne ka announcement kiya hai. Yeh industry ke liye kaafi राहत ki baat hai, considering the complexities involved in testing and certification.

Here are the key details:

*   **Old Due Date:** The previous deadline for compliance was July 26, 2026.
*   **New Due Date:** The compliance timeline has now been extended to **January 26, 2027**.
*   **Why the Extension?** This extension has been granted by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) through Notification S.O. 4182(E), acknowledging the industry's need for more time to meet the mandatory requirements for Television Sets under the Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2021.
*   **CBIC's Role:** The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) has issued Instruction No. 14/2026-Customs, dated August 7, 2026, to ensure that all Customs field officers are aware of this revised timeline and align port clearance protocols accordingly. This means that non-certified television sets will be permitted for customs clearance until the new deadline.
